sentences.japanese: 「はい」と「いいえ」しか言わない人と会話を続けるのは難しい。
sentences.english: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".

sentences.japanese: ２、３年でフランス語に熟達するのはきわめて難しい。
sentences.english: It's quite difficult to master French in 2 or 3 years.

sentences.japanese: 素晴らしい考えを思いつくのは難しい。
sentences.english: It's difficult to have great ideas.

sentences.japanese: あなたが思っているより難しい。
sentences.english: It's more difficult than you think.

sentences.japanese: 運転免許を取るのは、それほど難しくないと思うよ。
sentences.english: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
